summary.en: Four-species particle simulation API; configuration and lifecycle, without preset marketing.
summary.zh: 四物种粒子模拟 API，完整说明配置和生命周期，不将预设作为营销展示。

description.en: Create and initialize a four-species GPU particle simulation.
description.zh: 创建并初始化四物种 GPU 粒子模拟。

description.en: Simulation, rendering, and initialization options; all fields are detailed under ParticlesConfig.
description.zh: 模拟、渲染和初始化选项；所有字段详见 ParticlesConfig。

description.en: Initialized buffers and compute pipelines, without a render loop or attached canvas.
description.zh: 已初始化的缓冲和计算管线，尚无渲染循环，也未绑定画布。

constraints.en: World half-width is fixed by count: sqrt(count/16_000). Initial positions are seeded within ±0.8*worldHalf, velocities start at zero, and species indices are 0..3. No public worldHalf or species-count option exists.
constraints.zh: 世界半宽由 count 决定：sqrt(count/16_000)。初始位置位于 ±0.8*worldHalf，速度为零，物种编号为 0..3。不提供 worldHalf 或物种数公共选项。

constraints.en: The caller owns animation scheduling. tick works without attach for compute-only use. Attach a canvas once if built-in rendering is desired.
constraints.zh: 动画调度由调用者负责。无需 attach 也能 tick，支持纯计算。需要内置渲染时只 attach 一次画布。

constraints.en: WebGPU and the shared GpuContext are required. No WebGL or CPU fallback is provided. Resource use depends on count, grid resolution, and device limits.
constraints.zh: 需要 WebGPU 和共享 GpuContext。不提供 WebGL 或 CPU 回退。资源用量取决于数量、网格分辨率和设备限制。

errors.en: Rejects UsageError(ERR_USAGE) for invalid count/mode and n2 count >32_000. An unknown string force name throws plain Error. Device acquisition, buffer allocation, shader compilation, or pipeline validation can reject.
errors.zh: count/mode 无效或 n2 数量 >32_000 时拒绝，错误为 UsageError(ERR_USAGE)。未知字符串力名称抛普通 Error。设备获取、缓冲分配、shader 编译或管线校验也可能失败。

errors.en: Physical numeric options and custom force-matrix length/range are not comprehensively checked. Invalid numbers can reach GPU code; validate application input.
errors.zh: 不会全面校验物理数值选项或自定义力矩阵长度/范围。无效数值可能直接进入 GPU 代码，应由应用验证输入。

caption.en: Initialize once, render on animation frames, and stop scheduling before destroying.
caption.zh: 初始化一次，在动画帧中渲染，销毁前停止调度。

description.en: All options are optional; defaults below come from the installed 2.0.0 implementation.
description.zh: 所有选项均可选；以下默认值来自已安装 2.0.0 的实现。

description.en: Integer particle count in 1..1_000_000. n2 mode rejects counts above 32_000 (its error text recommends at most 20_000). Device memory limits may be lower.
description.zh: 粒子数量，整数范围 1..1_000_000。n2 模式拒绝超过 32_000 的数量（其错误文案建议不超过 20_000）。设备内存限制可能更低。

description.en: One of cells/snakes/orbitals/viruses, seeded random, or a readonly 16-number tuple. Four species use matrix[mySpecies*4+otherSpecies]; custom arrays are not length/range-validated here.
description.zh: 可选 cells/snakes/orbitals/viruses、带种子的 random 或只读 16 数值元组。四个物种按 matrix[mySpecies*4+otherSpecies] 取值；此处不校验自定义数组长度/范围。

description.en: Neighbor algorithm: all-pairs, workgroup-tiled all-pairs, or spatial grid. The declaration comment saying tiled is the default is stale; implementation defaults to grid.
description.zh: 邻域算法：全量两两计算、workgroup 分块两两计算或空间网格。声明中默认 tiled 的注释已过时；实现默认 grid。

description.en: Canvas coloring by four species or speed magnitude. Used when the renderer is attached.
description.zh: 画布按四种物种或速度大小着色，attach 渲染器时生效。

description.en: How updated positions remain in the square world: wrap or clamp. Interaction distances/neighborhood searches do not wrap across opposite edges.
description.zh: 更新后位置如何保持在方形世界内：环绕或钳位。交互距离/邻域搜索不会跨相对边界环绕。

description.en: Converted to String(seed), then hashed; initializes positions/species and the random force matrix deterministically.
description.zh: 转换为 String(seed) 后散列，确定性地初始化位置、物种和 random 力矩阵。

description.en: Maximum interaction radius in world units. Use a finite positive number. Also affects grid resolution.
description.zh: 世界单位下的最大交互半径，应使用有限正数，也影响网格分辨率。

description.en: Piecewise force-curve breakpoint at normalized distance d/rMax. Meaningful values are between 0 and 1; not validated by this API.
description.zh: 归一化距离 d/rMax 下的分段力曲线分界点。合理值在 0 与 1 之间；API 不验证。

description.en: Acceleration scale: summed interactions are multiplied by forceFactor*rMax before integration.
description.zh: 加速度缩放；交互总和在积分前乘以 forceFactor*rMax。

description.en: Damping time parameter used as exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife). Despite the name, implementation does not include ln(2), so this is an exponential decay time constant rather than a mathematical half-life. Use a positive finite value.
description.zh: 阻尼时间参数，实际公式为 exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife)。虽然名称含 HalfLife，实现没有 ln(2)，数学上是指数衰减时间常数，不是真正半衰期。应使用有限正数。

description.en: Base simulation time step per tick, multiplied by the tick argument. The animation callback elapsed time is not measured automatically.
description.zh: 每次 tick 的基础模拟时间步，乘以 tick 参数；不会自动测量动画回调经过的时间。

description.en: Normalized point-quad half-size used by the attached renderer, approximately in clip coordinates after world scaling. It is not a literal pixel size; shader generation rounds the scaled value to four decimals.
description.zh: attach 渲染器使用的归一化点四边形半尺寸，经世界缩放后近似为裁剪空间坐标尺寸。它不是直接像素值；shader 生成时会把缩放后的值保留四位小数。

description.en: Grid-only candidate budget: ceil(maxNeighbors/9) candidates per each of up to 9 neighboring cells (self may count). Use a finite positive number.
description.zh: 仅 grid 使用的候选预算：最多 9 个相邻格子，每格检查 ceil(maxNeighbors/9) 个候选（自身也可能计入）。应使用有限正数。

typeDetails.name: ForcePresetName (supporting, not exported by this entry point)

description.en: Literal names accepted as force selections. FORCE_PRESETS itself is not a public root or /particles export.
description.zh: 作为力配置接受的字面量名称。FORCE_PRESETS 本身不是根入口或 /particles 的公共导出。

typeDetails.name: ForceMatrix (supporting, not exported by this entry point)
typeDetails.type: readonly [number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number]

description.en: A flat 4×4 matrix; lookup is mySpecies*4+otherSpecies. Obtain this type without a private-path import using Exclude<NonNullable<ParticlesConfig["forces"]>, string>.
description.zh: 扁平 4×4 矩阵，下标为 mySpecies*4+otherSpecies。无需私有路径导入，可用 Exclude<NonNullable<ParticlesConfig["forces"]>, string> 获取此类型。

typeDetails.name: SimMode (supporting, not exported by this entry point)

description.en: Obtain through NonNullable<ParticlesConfig["mode"]>.
description.zh: 可通过 NonNullable<ParticlesConfig["mode"]> 获取。

constraints.en: maxNeighbors=Infinity does not disable the cap in 2.0.0 despite the declaration comment: DataView.setUint32 converts Infinity to 0, and the shader then processes no candidates. Use a sufficiently large finite budget when needed.
constraints.zh: 尽管声明注释这样描述，2.0.0 的 maxNeighbors=Infinity 并不会禁用上限：DataView.setUint32 将 Infinity 转为 0，shader 随后不处理任何候选。需要时应使用足够大的有限预算。

constraints.en: No package export exists for the internal config/presets file paths. Use public ParticlesConfig and its indexed types, not wgpu-kit/dist/... imports.
constraints.zh: 内部 config/presets 文件路径未在 package exports 中暴露。应使用公共 ParticlesConfig 及其索引类型，不要导入 wgpu-kit/dist/...。

examples.code:
import type { ParticlesConfig } from 'wgpu-kit/particles';
const options = {
  count: 2048,
  mode: 'grid',
  color: 'velocity',
  bounds: 'clamp',
  seed: 42,
  rMax: 0.12,
  beta: 0.3,
  forceFactor: 8,
  frictionHalfLife: 0.04,
  dt: 0.02,
  pointSize: 0.004,
  maxNeighbors: 8100,
  forces: [0, 0.4, -0.2, 0, -0.3, 0, 0.4, 0, 0.2, -0.3, 0, 0.4, 0, 0.2, -0.3, 0],
} satisfies ParticlesConfig;

caption.en: Validate configuration and a custom four-species matrix with TypeScript.
caption.zh: 使用 TypeScript 校验配置与自定义四物种矩阵。

description.zh: 选中的字面量力名称，或 'custom'；由 setForces() 更新。

description.en: 32-bit hash of the normalized seed string.

typeDetails.name: ResolvedConfig (supporting, not exported by this entry point)
typeDetails.type: { count: number; forces: ForceMatrix; forcesName: string; mode: SimMode; color: "species" | "velocity"; bounds: "wrap" | "clamp"; seed: string; seedHash: number; rMax: number; beta: number; forceFactor: number; friction: number; frictionHalfLife: number; dt: number; pointSize: number; maxNeighbors: number }

description.en: All fields are required on resolved output. Do not mutate config directly to control the simulation.
description.zh: 解析结果中所有字段均必有；不要直接修改 config 来控制模拟。

constraints.en: setParams changes a separate internal physics object, so config.rMax/beta/forceFactor/frictionHalfLife/dt/friction may remain initialization values. snapshot() reads the current physics values.
constraints.zh: setParams 修改另一个内部物理对象，因此 config.rMax/beta/forceFactor/frictionHalfLife/dt/friction 可能仍为初始化值。snapshot() 读取当前物理值。

description.en: Configure built-in particle rendering on one canvas.
description.zh: 在一个画布上配置内置粒子渲染。

description.en: Canvas with positive CSS client dimensions, not already acquired by an incompatible drawing backend.
description.zh: 具有有效 CSS 客户区尺寸的画布，不应已被不兼容绘制后端占用。

description.en: Resolves when the canvas renderer is ready.
description.zh: 画布渲染器就绪时完成。

constraints.en: Sets backing width/height to max(1, floor(clientSize*min(devicePixelRatio||1,2))). Configures opaque WebGPU rendering. No automatic resize observer is installed.
constraints.zh: 像素宽高设为 max(1, floor(clientSize*min(devicePixelRatio||1,2)))，配置不透明 WebGPU 渲染。不自动安装 resize observer。

constraints.en: Call once per simulation. A second call replaces the renderer reference without first destroying the previous renderer. attach does not start an animation loop.
constraints.zh: 每个模拟只调用一次。再次调用会替换渲染器引用，但不会先销毁旧渲染器。attach 不启动动画循环。

errors.en: Rejects if canvas.getContext("webgpu") is null or rendering shader/pipeline initialization fails.
errors.zh: canvas.getContext("webgpu") 返回 null 或渲染 shader/管线初始化失败时拒绝。

description.en: Advance one simulation step, optionally render it, and swap current state buffers.
description.zh: 推进一步模拟，按需渲染，并切换当前状态缓冲。

description.en: Multiplier applied to current dt. 0 freezes physical evolution but still submits work/renders/swaps/counts a tick; fractional values slow simulation.
description.zh: 当前 dt 的倍率。0 停止物理推进，但仍提交工作、渲染、交换缓冲并计一次 tick；小数可减慢模拟。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Submits its own command encoder; this high-level API does not expose prepare/encode/endSubmit. Returns before GPU completion. Skip tick entirely to pause GPU work.
constraints.zh: 自行提交 command encoder；此高层 API 不暴露 prepare/encode/endSubmit。返回时 GPU 不一定已完成。若要暂停 GPU 工作，应完全跳过 tick。

constraints.en: Integration uses effectiveDt=dt*dtMultiplier and damping exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife). It does not adapt to elapsed animation-frame time.
constraints.zh: 积分使用 effectiveDt=dt*dtMultiplier，阻尼为 exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife)。不会根据动画帧实际间隔自动调整。

description.en: Replace the force matrix without recreating the simulation.
description.zh: 无需重建模拟，替换力矩阵。

description.en: Same force selection types as ParticlesConfig.forces. random reuses the original seed, so repeated calls produce the same matrix.
description.zh: 与 ParticlesConfig.forces 相同的力配置类型。random 复用原始种子，因此重复调用得到同一矩阵。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Queues a write to the 16-f32 matrix buffer and updates config.forces/config.forcesName. It does not reset positions or velocities.
constraints.zh: 向 16 个 f32 的矩阵缓冲排队写入，并更新 config.forces/config.forcesName；不重置位置或速度。

errors.en: Unknown force strings throw plain Error. Custom matrix component count/type issues may propagate from Buffer.write; do not pass arbitrary-length arrays.
errors.zh: 未知力名称抛普通 Error。自定义矩阵分量数/类型问题可能从 Buffer.write 传播；不要传任意长度数组。

description.en: Patch current physics parameters; omitted fields retain their current values.
description.zh: 局部更新当前物理参数；省略字段保留当前值。

parameters.type: { rMax?: number; beta?: number; forceFactor?: number; frictionHalfLife?: number; dt?: number }

description.en: Partial physics update; all nested fields are optional.
description.zh: 物理参数的部分更新；嵌套字段均可省略。

description.en: Maximum interaction radius in world units. Use a finite positive number. Also affects grid resolution.

description.en: Acceleration scale: summed interactions are multiplied by forceFactor*rMax before integration.
description.zh: 加速度缩放；交互总和在积分前乘以 forceFactor*rMax。

description.en: Damping time parameter used as exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife). Despite the name, implementation does not include ln(2), so this is an exponential decay time constant rather than a mathematical half-life. Use a positive finite value.
description.zh: 阻尼时间参数，实际公式为 exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife)。虽然名称含 HalfLife，实现没有 ln(2)，数学上是指数衰减时间常数，不是真正半衰期。应使用有限正数。

description.zh: 每次 tick 的基础模拟时间步，乘以 tick 参数；不会自动测量动画回调经过的时间。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: No runtime numeric validation. Do not explicitly pass undefined for a field, because Object.assign would overwrite it.
constraints.zh: 没有运行时数值验证。不要显式把某字段设为 undefined，因为 Object.assign 会覆盖原值。

constraints.en: If rMax changes grid resolution, an asynchronous rebuild starts; only the latest rebuild wins and old grid resources are replaced. No promise or completion callback is exposed; rebuild errors are not caught here.
constraints.zh: 若 rMax 改变网格分辨率，会启动异步重建；仅最后一次重建生效并替换旧网格资源。不提供 Promise 或完成回调；此处不捕获重建错误。

description.en: Serialize selected current settings, not simulation state.
description.zh: 序列化选定的当前配置，不保存模拟状态。

description.en: JSON containing count, forces name, mode, color, bounds, seed, rMax, beta, forceFactor, frictionHalfLife, dt, pointSize.
description.zh: JSON 字符串，含 count、forces 名称、mode、color、bounds、seed、rMax、beta、forceFactor、frictionHalfLife、dt、pointSize。

constraints.en: Omits particle buffers, maxNeighbors, and the values of custom force matrices. A custom matrix becomes forces:"custom", which particles() cannot resolve as a named matrix; this is not a complete round-trip checkpoint.
constraints.zh: 省略粒子缓冲、maxNeighbors 和自定义力矩阵数值。自定义矩阵变为 forces:"custom"，particles() 无法按名称解析它；此方法不是完整可恢复检查点。

description.en: Read tick-frequency and uncaptured-error counters.
description.zh: 读取 tick 频率和未捕获错误计数。

description.en: fps starts at 0 and updates when accumulated wall time reaches about 500 ms. gpuErrors counts device uncapturederror events observed by this instance.
description.zh: fps 初始为 0，在累计墙钟时间达到约 500 ms 时更新。gpuErrors 统计此实例监听到的设备 uncapturederror 事件。

description.en: Ticks per elapsed wall-clock second, not GPU kernel duration or a benchmark score. Long pauses can affect the next sample.
description.zh: 每墙钟秒的 tick 数，不是 GPU kernel 耗时或性能基准分数。长暂停会影响下一次样本。

description.en: Shared-device uncaptured error count; events may originate from other work using that device.
description.zh: 共享设备的未捕获错误数量；事件可能来自使用同一设备的其他工作。

returns.type: { pos: Buffer; vel: Buffer; species: Buffer }

description.en: pos/vel are count-element vec2f buffers; species is a count-element u32 buffer.
description.zh: pos/vel 为 count 个 vec2f 元素的缓冲，species 为 count 个 u32 元素的缓冲。

description.en: Current 2D world positions.
description.zh: 当前二维世界位置。

description.en: Current 2D velocities.
description.zh: 当前二维速度。

description.en: Species labels 0..3, independent of ping-pong state.
description.zh: 0..3 的物种标签，独立于双缓冲状态。

constraints.en: pos and vel alternate after tick; call buffers() again for the latest side. CPU snapshots require await buffer.read(). The simulation owns these buffers.
constraints.zh: tick 后 pos 和 vel 交替，获取最新侧须再次调用 buffers()。CPU 快照需要 await buffer.read()。这些缓冲由模拟拥有。

caption.en: Obtain the current side after ticking, then read a snapshot.
caption.zh: tick 后取得当前侧，再读取快照。

description.en: Release the simulation-owned particle, matrix, uniform, grid, and renderer resources handled by this implementation.
description.zh: 释放实现中负责清理的粒子、矩阵、uniform、网格和渲染器资源。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Cancel your animation loop and stop using borrowed buffers first. No automatic RAF cancellation, canvas unconfiguration, disposed-state guard, or error-listener removal is provided.
constraints.zh: 先取消动画循环并停止使用借用缓冲。不自动取消 RAF、不取消画布配置、不提供销毁状态防护，也不移除错误监听器。

constraints.en: Avoid destroying while an asynchronous setParams grid rebuild is pending: 2.0.0 does not expose a way to await or cancel that rebuild.
constraints.zh: 避免在 setParams 异步重建网格期间销毁；2.0.0 不提供等待或取消该重建的方式。

typeDetails.name: ForcePresetName (supporting, not exported by this entry point)

description.en: Literal names accepted as force selections. FORCE_PRESETS itself is not a public root or /particles export.
description.zh: 作为力配置接受的字面量名称。FORCE_PRESETS 本身不是根入口或 /particles 的公共导出。

typeDetails.name: ForceMatrix (supporting, not exported by this entry point)
typeDetails.type: readonly [number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number]

description.en: A flat 4×4 matrix; lookup is mySpecies*4+otherSpecies. Obtain this type without a private-path import using Exclude<NonNullable<ParticlesConfig["forces"]>, string>.
description.zh: 扁平 4×4 矩阵，下标为 mySpecies*4+otherSpecies。无需私有路径导入，可用 Exclude<NonNullable<ParticlesConfig["forces"]>, string> 获取此类型。

typeDetails.name: SimMode (supporting, not exported by this entry point)

description.en: Obtain through NonNullable<ParticlesConfig["mode"]>.
description.zh: 可通过 NonNullable<ParticlesConfig["mode"]> 获取。
